notes: Paper studies resonant CMB photon-to-axion conversion inside large-scale structure (axion-photon coupling g_agamma). The title/focus 'FIRAS' refers to the real observed bound derived from COBE/FIRAS spectral-distortion data (Fig. 2, blue region, 99% CL), which excludes g_agamma down to about 1e-9 GeV^-1 over the axion mass range ~2e-13 to 3e-12 eV (natural cutoff at ma ~ 3e-12 eV). Exact per-mass values are not tabulated; I encode the FIRAS bound as a roughly flat line at ~1e-9 GeV^-1 across the stated mass range. The bulk of the paper is a Planck/CMB-S4+unWISE sensitivity FORECAST reaching g_agamma ~ 3e-12 GeV^-1 (Planck) and ~an order of magnitude better for CMB-S4, but those are projections; the extracted numbers are the actual FIRAS-derived exclusion. Pre-analysis hint of DarkPhoton is incorrect: this paper constrains axion-photon coupling (its companion 'Paper I' treats dark photons).
